t: Induction-hardened hook blade with point that makes it ideal for penetrating cutting sheet material. Blade shape helps prevent damage to materials beneath cutting surface. Ideal for cutting and trimming roofing materials, linoleum, carpet, fabric, cartons, and sheet materials. Manufactured from 1905 carbide steel. Fits all standard Stanley utility knives.
